pm_review_routing_change.round2_fix: baseline must equal the start_head of the earliest commit that introduced the sprint id, that baseline must precede the creation commit, and the creation commit must precede the reviewed HEAD
pm_review_routing_change.artifact_digest_tolerance: a recorded digest is accepted only when Git can reproduce it for the approved revision, or when it hashes the artifact on disk and that artifact equals the committed blob under CRLF/LF normalisation; approvals also record artifacts_canonical.
